pages.text: Well done - you've got the centrepiece of this mod. Hold [$(k:use)] and you'll see particles gathering at your feet in an ever-widening circle, showing the area that is about to travel with you.

Hold [$(k:use)] for the full 6 seconds and you, along with everything else inside the circle, are carried into your soul. This is how you'd bring friends and livestock along.$(p)You do not take your body with you. It stays sitting where you stood - see $(l:soulhome:basics/vessel)The Body You Leave$(/l).

The key works anywhere, with nothing built for it - which is why it is the slow way in, and why the body it leaves takes a hit as hard as you would.$(p)At home, a $(l:soulhome:basics/meditation)Meditation Cushion$(/l) is quicker, and the body it leaves is sturdier. The key is for when you are nowhere near one.
pages.title: The Long Way In

pages.text: All you need is a little bit of iron and an ender pearl
pages.title: SoulKey
